question: How is Bhairava described as fully empowered in this phase of emanation?
premises: By this extent the God of gods is full of power.
His nature is reflective awareness operating through emission and withdrawal.
inference: Bhairava is fully empowered as reflective awareness that manifests through the twin movements of emission and withdrawal.
plain_english: To this extent the God of gods, Bhairava, is full of power; his nature is reflective awareness, operating through emission and withdrawal.
